name: Jina Affiliation Reranker (COMET triplets only)
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from jinaai/jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual (config.json max_position_embeddings 1026). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: cross-encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full bidirectional attention over query+passage
notes: ADDED 2026-11-06. A full fine-tune of jinaai/jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual into a cross-encoder for scholarly affiliation-string matching (ROR disambiguation), not a new base model: identical 278M parameter tensor set, same XLM-RoBERTa config. Trained 3 epochs on ~8K COMET triplets (80% hard negatives), lr 2e-5, BinaryCrossEntropyLoss, 15% validation split; the repo name's 'comet-training-only' distinguishes it from the sibling affiliation rerankers that train on the wider COMET corpus. Recorded as a contender because it prints a base column and a fine-tuned column in one tier table on 300 hand-built affiliation pairs. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0 (inherited from the base, non-commercial), repo created 2025-12-29. NOTE: the eval is the author's own 300-case tiered suite, not a public benchmark, and the tier breakdown is what carries the signal - the overall +6.0 points is concentrated in Abbreviations (+20) and International (+8.6) tiers while five tiers sit at parity.
